Japandi Sternschale - Herbstdeko & Organizer

https://makerworld.com/de/models/3304820-japandi-star-bowl-autumn-decor-organizer?from=recommend#profileId-3751232

Bring a warm autumn touch to your home with this Japandi-inspired decorative bowl. Its star-shaped base, gently undulating rim and fine vertical ribs create a sculptural silhouette that combines Japanese-inspired simplicity with Nordic style.

Designed as a versatile home accessory, it can be used as a catchall for keys and small everyday items, a fruit bowl for displaying whole fruit, or a centerpiece for your dining table, coffee table or sideboard. It also makes a beautiful base for an autumn arrangement with decorative pumpkins, pinecones and dried leaves.

The ribbed surface catches the light and adds texture, while the open shape keeps the overall look calm and understated. Choose warm neutral tones such as sand, beige, terracotta or brown for a cozy seasonal display, or match the color to your interior for year-round styling.

A practical decorative accent for Japandi, Scandinavian and minimalist spaces, equally at home in an entryway, living room, kitchen or dining area.

Druckeinstellungen:
- Druckprofil: 150mm large - 0.2mm layer, 2 walls, 15% infill
- Schichthöhe: 0.2 mm
- Wandlinien: 2
- Infill: 15%
- Filament: PLA (#D3B7A7)
